batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c SL Malinga b KA Pollard

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b Z Khan

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c HV Patel b M Muralitharan

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c TM Dilshan b HV Patel

balls.text: driven with power towards wide long on, where Rohit fields
Agarwal is pasting Munaf, he moved back and towards the off side, using the depth of his crease to shorten the length, get under the ball and hammer it over deep midwicket

that would have been a fourth boundary in the over had Rohit Sharma not charged to his left from long on and dived full length, pushing the ball to Pollard, who was sprinting from long off. agarwal had charged and lofted a length ball over the bowler's head
another pie from Munaf, a full toss outside off stump, Agarwal slams it wide off the fielder at long-off
that's his fifty, off 26 deliveries, Gayle's fastest this season is off 24, to give you some perspective. A half-volley outside off and Agarwal square drives with power through point
the first ball is a rubbish full toss, Agarwal steps out of his crease and lofts the ball over the wide long-off boundary. Munaf watches it disappear
in the blockhole this time and Agarwal works the ball behind square
over cover! Agarwal clears his front foot to create hitting space and smashes the slower ball bowled on a length over the boundary, superb timing
the yorker goes wrong for Malinga, Agarwal stays in his crease and chips the half-volley off his pads into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary
he stays in his crease this time and swats the short of a length ball to long on
he does! He comes out of his crease and slogs mightily, Malinga delivered the slower ball that beat the batsman completely and passed over middle stump
a slower ball on a good length outside off, steered off the back foot towards Gibbs at backward point
short of a length and at the body, Zaheer defends off the back foot

Vinay's been run out! He steered a short of a length ball towards deep point and wanted the second. Smith was the fielder sprinting in from the boundary and his throw to Karthik was powerful and accurate. Vinay sprinted and dived full length but was still a foot out of his crease when Karthik uprooted all three stumps
good length outside off, played back to the bowler
off stump's taken a walk. RP Singh bowled a full toss, Dilshan moved towards leg to hit through the off side, the ball swerved slightly away from the right-hander and Dilshan missed it
in the blockhole this time, Agarwal makes room and hits it towards mid-off
short and wide outside off, Agarwal makes room and carves it over the keeper, a top edge really but he was looking to hit in the vicinity. Rubbish ball
the quick bouncer, Dilshan tries to hook but is beaten
a full toss on the pads, Dilshan flicked with power towards long leg, Sachin had to hurry to his left from fine leg and intercept the ball that was racing towards the boundary
good length but a touch too straight, Agarwal flicks the ball off the pads through square leg, Dilshan wanted the second but Smith had got to the ball too quickly so Agarwal said no
Dilshan uses the width outside off to steer to third man
in the blockhole and I think that was just inside the tram line outside off stump, the umpire's called it wide though
a slower ball outside off stump, Dilshan cut too early and was beaten
good length but with width outside off, Agarwal cuts from the crease through point
he makes room again but this time mis-hits the ball in the air towards extra cover
shot! Agarwal makes room by moving towards leg and lofts a length ball cleanly through the line, clearing the long-off boundary with ease
another one in the blockhole, Dilshan tries to work through square leg but gets a leading edge on the off side
in the blockhole this time, Agarwal plays towards long off
short of a length delivery and Agarwal slices the ball off the front foot over the leaping Gibbs at backward point
good length just outside off, cut off the back foot to Gibbs at point, he throws at the bowler's end, Dilshan wants the overthrow but Agarwal does not
what's going on today? Slippery fingers? RP sprays the ball wide outside off stump
Dilshan makes room by moving towards leg and drives a full ball to long-on, he calls for two but only gets one
Agarwal tried to pull but bottom edges a short of a length ball on to his leg
driven to mid off for a single
Munaf runs to his left from third man and dives, he gets a hand on the ball but can't prevent the four. Dilshan had charged the bowler and then cut the short of a length ball
good length, skidding towards middle stump, Dilshan stays in his crease and plays to midwicket
Agarwal tries to pull a short of a length ball that hurries on to him but misses and is hit on the thigh, RCB reach 100
fuller outside off stump, driven firmly but to the fielder on the cover boundary
Agarwal gives Pollard the charge but is met with a short of a length ball, he hit through the line, lofting the ball flat over extra cover, he was cramped for room but made clean contact
good length and slower outside off, Agarwal plays from the crease to cover
a third wide in the over down leg side, Pollard is going wide of the crease and hence slanting it down
played from the crease towards midwicket
another wide down leg side, Mumbai have been generous today
this time Dilshan moved forward towards the ball and opened the face to steer towards third man, Dilshan sprinted the first, looking for two, but Agarwal was strolling it and couldn't come back
Dilshan tries to steer a good length ball towards third man but did not move his feet, he was beaten by the movement into him
Karthik skips to his left and dives full length to collect an extremely wayward ball down leg side
now he tries to steer to third man but is beaten outside off stump
another sharp offcutter, Agarwal stays back and blocks, he had to hurry the shot
Smith pitches on a good length outside off stump and cuts it back into Dilshan, who stays in his crease and cuts to third man
opens the face this time and steers to third man
the ball cuts back into the right-hander from a good length, it was a skiddy delivery and Agarwal was late on the pull, he hit the ball into the ground near his feet
good length on off and middle, Agarwal defends on the back foot
good length and slower, Dilshan drives too early, playing to point
quicker ball on a good length outside off, Dilshan gets beaten on the cut
Pollard goes wide of the crease and aims for the blockhole, Agarwal clips to mid-on

AB's gone, caught at mid-off! He backed away towards leg and tried to smash inside out over the off side. It was the slower ball on middle stump and AB didn't get any elevation on the shot, Malinga tumbled after moving to his left to take the catch. That was hit quite hard
Dilshan drives from his crease to long-on
AB moves towards leg and clips the ball behind square
hit to deep square leg for a single
that's a wide down leg side, Karthik can't collect cleanly

Dwayne Smith leaps on the edge of the deep midwicket boundary, he gets a hand on it but can't prevent the ball from going over. Dilshan had stepped out, got under the ball and heaved across the line. Smith jumped extremely high, lesser fielders wouldn't have touched it
played off the back foot towards long on
shot! AB backed away towards leg to make room and slapped the ball flat over the infield at cover and into the gap on the boundary. He hit that very late and from middle stump
bowled flatter and quicker from round the wicket, Dilshan stays back and plays through square leg
AB backs away and hits a low full toss to long-off
slower ball outside off, AB taps it wide off the keeper and runs
fuller length outside off, Dilshan spoons the drive over cover
Dilshan gives Pollard the charge and then steers a short of a length ball to the fine third man boundary, clever adjustment to the length
steered towards third man off the back foot
this one is quicker, Dilshan tries to cut but is beaten by the short of a length ball that angles into him
short of a length outside off with some movement away from the right-hander, Dilshan tries to drive on the up but is beaten
flicked through square leg for a single
Munaf's messed up on the backward point boundary, Dilshan cut a wide ball firmly and Munaf ran to his left and got to it comfortably. He stooped to field but the ball went through him
worked of the pads through square leg
tries to slog sweep but gets a bottom edge towards short fine leg
driven from the crease towards cover
Dilshan goes back to flick but misses and is hit on the pad, Harbhajan appeals but that pitched outside leg
Malinga unleashes the straight yorker, zeroing in on AB's shoes, he nimbly moves his feet out of the way and flicks through midwicket. Terrific ball and superbly played
fuller and straighter, Dilshan drives to long on to bring up the 50
Malinga gets some serious bounce with the fast bouncer, Dilshan sways and lets it go
the attempted yorker ends up as a straight, low full toss, AB whips it off his pads, along the ground to the fielder at deep square leg
good length just outside off, AB drives from his crease to cover
length ball with width outside off, AB cuts to point
nudged off the pads to short fine leg
played off the back foot to midwicket
driven off the front foot to long on

would you believe it, Tiwary has stepped on to his stumps. He took a step back into his crease to work the ball through square leg and then before beginning to run he took another small step back. Unfortunately for him middle stump was in the way
shot! Tiwary made room by moving towards leg and lofted the ball inside out, hitting it cleanly over the long-off boundary. Sweet connection
Dilshan sweeps the ball along the ground to deep square leg
good length and straight, defended on the front foot
a third slower ball, Tiwary steers it towards point
the slower ball down leg side, that's a wide

Tiwary tries to slog a slower ball but ends up slicing it high in the air beyond the circle at extra cover, RP Singh should have run to his right from mid-off but he did not. Pollard couldn't get to it from cover

Dilshan drives into the ground and over the bowler, RP from mid-on runs to his left and dives to intercept, he ends up pushing the ball towards mid-off, where there was no fielder because the fielder had run to his right to back up RP
the fielder at mid-off dives to his left to try and catch the lofted drive but drops it. A tough chance for RP Singh. Tiwary had checked his shot and ended up spooning the ball
pushed off the front towards mid-on

and maybe that's why, a length offering around off stump, Tiwary has room to swing his arms and he does with power, pulling the ball off the front foot far over the midwicket boundary. The endless over has finally ended
good length on off stump, pushed off the front foot to cover point
a quick short of a length ball outside off, Dilshan tries to hoick over midwicket but gets beaten, Munaf wants to have a chat with Dilshan, despite having bowled terribly

this is atrocious now, Munaf's over-stepped again, and bowled a full ball outside off stump, Dilshan drills the ball through cover. Munaf's over-stepped by a long way, and he's having words with the umpire for some reason. Temper temper ...
a fast full toss but it's down leg side, Munaf's lost it me thinks
he's bowled a superb yorker but he's over-stepped again, Tiwary could only drive it to mid-on. Dilshan can have a go now against a free-hit.
full and straighter ball, Tiwary drives hard into the ground and into Munaf, who had over-stepped. So there's a free hit coming up. Tiwary can swing for the rafters

that's a poor shot but it's gone for four, Tiwary slogged at a good length ball, hitting across the line. Somehow it went straight over the bowler's head. Harbhajan chased from mid-on but this outfield is quick
not short enough to pull, but Tiwary tries to anyway, swinging hard. Mis-timed to midwicket
that's a bit full and on the pads, fine leg is in the circle but Dilshan doesn't make proper contact with the flick
Tiwary swishes because there's more width outside of stump and gets beaten
Tiwary tries to bash the ball down the ground but the length is too good and he mis-times it to the bowler
pushed towards extra cover and Dilshan sets off immediately, the fielder from extra cover comes running  in and scores a direct hit but Dilshan is safe
played off the front foot, opening the face to steer towards third man
Tiwary strides forward and lets a good length ball go outside off
RP angles the ball into the left-hander from over the wicket, pitching on a good length around off stump, and then seams it away. Tiwary prods and is beaten
driven on the up, in the air but short of the fielder at short cover
good length with some movement away from the right-hander, Dilshan tries to drive on the up and is beaten

sensation fielding from Gibbs at point, a terrible mix-up between the batsmen, and Kohli is thundering as he's run out. Dilshan cut the ball hard towards backward point, and Kohli set off for the single. Gibbs moved swiftly and dived to his left, and sprang up immediately with the ball in his hands. Kohli slipped as he put on the brakes when he saw Dilshan wasn't running. Gibbs lobbed the ball back to Munaf, and Kohli had given up by then
strays on to the pads and Kohli gets going with a neat clip through midwicket

middle stump has been knocked back, and the Mumbai Indians come running from far and wide to celebrate this huge wicket. Gayle cleared his front foot and made room to heave over the leg side, the length was too good for that shot. He got a thick inside edge, a powerful inside edge, and middle stump took a battering
good length but a bit straight, played off the pads through square leg

Gayle came forward, backed away towards leg and swung with might, he didn't connect, else someone on the road outside might have had a ball heading their way, RP has his hands on his head because that was close to off stump
Dilshan tried to let that go outside off but made the decision to lift his bat out of the way a bit too late, the ball hit the face and went towards third man
short of a length around off, Dilshan drives from the crease to cover
a low full toss with some late swing into the right-hander after angling across him from over the wicket, Dilshan plays back to the bowler
there's width outside off stump on a very hittable length, Dilshan cuts but can't beat point
good length on off and middle from RP Singh from over the wicket, Dilshan defends
fetch that from row 15 beyond the long-on boundary, a length delivery on middle and off and Gayle simply lofted through the line on the front foot, destroying hopes of a maiden over
he cuts again, but mis-times it towards the fielder at point, the length was good from Munaf on off stump
short of a length around off stump, Gayle plays his first shot, cutting the ball hard, but can't beat the man at point
that's fuller and wider outside off stump, Gayle lets it go again, a gentle start from this T20 giant
good length around off stump with some good bounce through to the keeper after Gayle lifts his bat out of the way
pitches on a good length around off stump and angles it across the left-hander, Gayle doesn't move much and decides to let it go

that's it, it's all over! Pollard has pulled the ball with all his might towards deep midwicket and the fielder is powerless, the ball bursts through his dive. Rayudu and Pollard have rescued a floundering chase
that's a lucky boundary! Pollard was looking to heave on the leg side, the outside edge flew towards Zaheer at short third man and beat him
Pollard's hoisted the full ball off his pads and over the midwicket boundary! That was just a flick and it carried a long way
Rayudu charges again and the full toss clips the back foot outside leg stump, Gayle bowled that quickly
Rayudu steps out, towards the of side, and swings the ball hard towards short fine leg, Murali doesn't make a clean stop
a full toss on the pads and Pollard lifts it towards deep midwicket, Zaheer's lucky not to go for more
in the blockhole from round the wicket, played from the crease through midwicket
driven towards mid off for a single
another full toss around off stump, what's going on with the lengths? Pollard slogs and gets an outside edge that goes wide of AB to the third man boundary
a high full toss outside off stump and Rayudu loses grip of his bat after he charges and swings across the line, he ends up slicing the ball over cover
an accurate yorker to end the over, Pollard keeps it out

another slower ball, full and wide outside off, driven hard towards deep cover for just the single, Pollard wanted new gloves after the single and was looking at the dug out, Rayudu wanted an overthrow and got sent back in the nick of time
that's length and that's gone far over the straight boundary, Rayudu clears his front foot and swings hard, smashing the ball into the sightscreen
the slower ball with oodles of width outside off stump, a short ball as well, Rayudu helps himself, blasting to the extra cover boundary
a full toss, slanting across Rayudu, who simply slams it over long-off, where Appanna runs to his left and dives full length, but the ball falls over the boundary
in the blockhole, Pollard backs away to heave down the ground but gets an inside edge towards square leg
Rayudu tries to flick a low full toss through square leg but gets a leading edge that goes safely over point
that's a harsh call in my opinion, Rayudu had moved a long way across his stumps to swing behind square and so Zaheer's ball went past leg stump
Pollard moves towards the off side and pulls the ball towards fine leg
a full ball outside off stump, Pollard stays back in his crease, clears his front foot and hammers the ball along the ground past the bowler, long-off has no chance
played towards deep midwicket for a single
and the slip just watches as Rayudu pulls a short of a length ball off the front foot, high and far over the midwicket boundary
hit hard off the back foot towards long off, just the single though
Pollard is foxed by the slower ball, it hits him on the thigh again, they run a leg bye after the ball drops close on the off side
slightly short and Pollard pulls it flat and towards deep midwicket, where Dilshan dives but can't reach the ball to prevent the four
Pollard's lost grip of his bat as he lofts the ball behind square, the bat lands in the middle of the pitch and the ball over the fielder at short fine leg. It was a slower delivery
Rayudu stays back and plays a short arm pull through backward square leg
Pollard swings hard towards the leg side once again, he misses, the length was a bit fuller, Harshal appeals for lbw but that was missing leg
Pollard swivels and tries to pull a good length ball over square leg, he missed and got hit on the thigh
another full toss but Gayle gets away with it, Rayudu had backed away to hit through the off side but ended up slicing towards point
this time he's drilled it past the bowler for four, reaches his half-century with that shot, he needs to bat through for Mumbai
a full toss on the pads, Pollard doesn't make proper contact and plays it to fine leg
Rayudu steps out to a full toss and lofts towards long-off, where the fielder is rather straight
short ball and Rayudu slog sweeps down on one knee, pulling the ball to the deep square leg boundary
played off the pads towards deep midwicket
punched off the back foot towards long off
defended on the front foot towards the off side
driven to long on for a single
pushed off the front foot towards midwicket
played off the back foot through square

Pollard's been run out. He's walking off, not waiting for the third umpire's verdict. But hang on, replays show that his incredible dive, full length, bat gripping the top of the handle and fully outstretched, has saved him. Rayudu had cut the ball hard to point where Appanna dived to his left, sprang up, and threw to de Villiers. Only Pollard could have made his crease, used his incredible reach to inch over the line
played off the back foot through point
Rayudu moves forward and muscles the ball into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on, he got under the ball and heaved
a friendly full toss and Rayudu smashes it over the umpire's head, Gayle stuck his arm out but it was too quick for him
Rayudu drives firmly towards cover, "Run him out!" yells AB, but the batsmen decide against the run
a full toss on the pads, flicked towards deep backward square leg
played off the pads towards short fine leg
Gayle's first ball is a wide down leg side
that's the straighter one, bowled quick outside off, Pollard pushes forward and is beaten
fired down leg side, that was quick, AB hurries to his left to collect
defended on the back foot towards square leg
width outside off stump, but Rayudu's backfoot drive goes to cover
fuller ball but same result, Pollard hoisted it over the wide long-on boundary with immense power, stand and hit stuff
he's dragged that short outside off, giving Pollard room, he simply smashed it high over the bowler's head and over the sightscreen
driven on the front foot on the off side

Rayudu gives Appanna the charge and uses the width outside off to free his arms and drive the ball flat over extra cover. Did that hit the boundary rope on the full? The on-field umpire is checking with the TV umpire. It was just short
tossed up on leg stump, Pollard drives off his pads through square leg
Rayudu steps out and drives past the bowler, Appanna dived to his left but couldn't stop it
width outside off and the batsman goes back to cut towards deep point
driven off the front foot to wide long on
Pollard stays back and pushes the ball gently towards wide long on
played towards point off the back foot
nudged off the front foot to midwicket
cut towards point
good length outside off, Pollard moves forward and plays towards cover
caught at point! Smith square drove, reaching for the ball away from his body and spooning it towards Dilshan, who caught it at head height. Mumbai in free fall at the moment
that's rocketed to the backward square leg boundary, it was short and Smith pulled with a lot of power
full ball on the pads, flicked towards deep square leg
good length on off and middle, pushed towards mid off for a single
a yorker hits Smith's pads, but it was going down leg side, so the umpire turned down the appeal
the straighter one, cut off the back foot towards point

caught at long leg! Karthik moved forward and towards the off side and played a powerful slog sweep, hitting the ball flat and hard but in the air. Harshal Patel covered considerable ground, running to his right on the boundary and caught the ball while on the move
steps out of his crease and nearly gets beaten by the flight, Rayudu has to lunge to play the ball behind square
played toward deep midwicket for one more single
tossed up on off stump, driven on the front foot towards long off
that wasn't very magical, Karthik nudges off his pads through square leg
Dilshan can't stop it again at point but Appanna sprints to his right from third man and dives full length to make a terrific save, Rayudu had cut that firmly off the back foot
cut hard off the back foot to Dilshan at point, the ball bounces off his leg behind cover, allowing the second run
another short ball, this time Rayudu moves back and across and pulls through midwicket, Tiwary's too slow on the boundary to cut that off
defended back to the bowler
a short ball, and Rayudu makes good contact with the pull but Vinay moves quickly from mid-on to his right to cut it off, he throws it at the bowler's end, forcing Karthik to hurry back
Rayudu tries to cut but misses a good length ball outside off stump
moves across his stumps and swings a good length ball towards Harshal at short fine leg
Rayudu steps out but makes his move a bit too early, Vinay shortens his length and cramps the batsman for room, Rayudu plays on the off side
steps out of his crease and drives towards wide mid-off, Kohli cuts it off from extra cover and flings the ball at the bowler's end, nearly went for four overthrows, Appanna had to make the save
short of a length outside off, Karthik moves forward and square drives on the up to point
Rayudu stays on the back foot and opens the face to steer the good length ball from off stump behind point
that's a short ball but it's a bit too short, it ballooned over the batsman
good length on off stump, Rayudu stays on the back foot and blocks
short and wide outside off, Rayudu cuts hard towards Appanna at third man, he is a good fielder
defended on the back foot towards the bowler

short of a length outside off stump, cut off the back foot towards wide third man, Appanna's throw to AB is decent and had AB hit with the backhand throw (he had to collect away from the stumps), the batsman would have been struggling
good length, pinning Rayudu to his crease, he defends on the off side
that's down leg side, we've seen a few of those today
good length outside off, played off the back foot towards point
Rayudu tries to play on the leg side but doesn't connect properly

Zaheer lumbers to his right from mid-on and dives, but can't stop Karthik's drive from beating him and going to the boundary. Karthik came out of his crease and timed the ball well through wide mid-on
Rayudu gets a bottom edge into the ground near his feet and sprints the single, he was trying to play with soft hands on the off side

caught and bowled! Rohit closed the face and tried to play a short of a length ball from around off stump towards the leg side. He got a leading edge that spooned towards Vinay, one of the easiest caught and bowleds a bowler can hope for
length ball around off stump, Rohit pulls but can't beat Zaheer at mid-on
shot! Rohit moved outside leg stump to hit on the off side, Vinay followed him, trying to cramp him for room, Rohit got under the full ball and lofted straight over the bowler
driven from the crease towards cover
Zaheer goes round the wicket and angles the ball into the right-hander, Karthik stays in his crease and plays towards point
"Good shot," says AB, as Karthik moves forward and drives a length ball off his pads through wide mid-on. "Good balance," says AB.
Karthik takes two steps out and swings a short of a length ball off his hips to the deep square leg boundary
"Run him out," says AB once again after Karthik pushes close on the off side and makes a forward movement. He doesn't run this time.
good length on middle and off again, Karthik moves forward and defends again
good length on middle and off, Karthik moves forward and across to defend
steered towards third man for a single
defended on the front foot
that's down leg side and the batsman misses the flick, AB and the bowler appeal, that hit the pad but the umpire calls it wide
good length outside off, Rohit plays the ball towards third man
played towards point

that's not too short but Gibbs stays back and short-arm jabs it over midwicket .... "Run him out!!" screams AB into the microphone, as Gibbs goes back for a very risky third run. Appanna was the fielder in pursuit of the ball and he made good time, slid and was up in a flash, firing the throw to Vinay, who broke the stumps with Gibbs a long way short. Mumbai are halfway into that hole now. Bizarre running, they ambled the first two runs and then sprinted for the third. Maybe they assumed it was going for four?
Vinay pitches his first ball on a good length outside off stump and seams it away a little, Gibbs lets it go
played from the crease towards point

caught at short cover! Kohli was stationed there for this shot and isn't he pumped after taking a sharp catch. Tendulkar reached forward and away from his body at a delivery that slanted away from him and spooned the square drive in the air. He hit it firmly, just straight to the fielder.
that's outside leg stump so Gibbs can work the ball behind square
Zaheer's got the ball on a string, seaming it away from Gibbs, who tried to push off the front foot but was all at sea
Zaheer curves a full ball away from Gibbs, lots of swing, Gibbs pushes off the back foot but is beaten outside off stump
length ball slanting across the right-hander, that's not outside the tram line but the umpire calls it wide
good length with some swing into the right-hander, Gibbs drives from his crease towards the off side
